description: Telecommunications in New Developments is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department of Infrastructure, Transport, Regional Development, Communications, Sport and the Arts. These datasets are supplied by carriers and provide information about the new developments they have contracted to service, including geo-spatial information about the location and boundaries of the development. The data is presented on the National Map by the Department of Communications and the Arts' website. Coverage: Department of Infrastructure, Transport, Regional Development, Communications, Sport and the Arts. The portal files it under the publisher Department of Infrastructure, Transport, Regional Development, Communications, Sport and the Arts. Its tags are Utilities and Communication, newdevelopments, telecommunications, tind. It offers 21 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON, KML, SLD, WFS. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
